routes.list.title: Alert routes
routes.details.title: Route details
routes.details.empty: Click a route name to inspect matchers, group by, channels and intake token prefix.
routes.form.subtitle: Match incoming alerts and deliver them to rotations and channels.
routes.form.route_section_hint: Team, source, rotation and notification channels.
routes.form.name: Name
routes.form.sentry_secret_new_help: Create the route first to get the Sentry webhook URL. Then create a Sentry Internal Integration and paste its Client Secret here.
routes.form.sentry_secret_configured_hel: Sentry webhook secret is configured. Leave empty to keep the existing secret.
routes.form.sentry_secret_missing_help: Paste Sentry Client Secret here. Until it is configured, Sentry webhooks will be rejected.
routes.form.sentry_base_url_help: Used as fallback when webhook payload does not include an event URL. For self-hosted Sentry, use your Sentry root URL.
routes.form.sentry_org_help: Used together with issue_id to build a fallback Sentry issue link.
routes.form.sns_topic_help: Only signed SNS messages from this exact topic will be accepted.
routes.form.sns_webhook_help: Add this HTTPS endpoint as an HTTP/S subscription of the SNS topic. No route intake token is required because SNS requests are verified by signature and Topic ARN.
routes.notification.route_only_help: Only channels configured directly on this route are used.
routes.notification.service_policy_help: Only channels selected by the matched service notification policy will receive shared notifications.
routes.notification.combined_help: Channels selected by the service policy are combined with the channels configured on this route.
routes.form.disabled_help: Disabled routes stay visible, but stop accepting incoming alerts.
routes.form.no_preset_hint: No preset selected. Only the additional matchers below will be evaluated.
routes.form.matchers_help: Matchers are JSON object filters. Group by is a JSON array of label names used for alert aggregation. Leave it empty to keep each dedup key in its own group.
routes.intake.title: Route intake details
routes.intake.copy_now: Copy these values now. The token may not be shown again.
routes.intake.send_url: Send incoming alerts to this URL.
routes.intake.token_help: Use this token as an Authorization Bearer token.
routes.rules.title: Service rules
routes.rules.subtitle: Match alerts inside this route to affected services.
routes.rules.name: Name
routes.permissions.edit: Team manager or group editor/admin role is required to edit this route.
routes.permissions.regenerate: Team manager or group editor/admin role is required to regenerate route tokens.
routes.permissions.rules: Team manager or group editor/admin role is required to manage service rules.
routes.permissions.toggle: Team manager or group editor/admin role is required to enable or disable this route.
routes.permissions.delete: Delete permission is required to delete this route.
routes.permissions.rules_denied: You do not have permission to manage service rules for this route.
routes.permissions.edit_denied: You do not have permission to edit this route.
routes.permissions.disable_denied: You do not have permission to disable this route.
routes.permissions.enable_denied: You do not have permission to enable this route.

routes.permissions.regenerate_denied: You do not have permission to regenerate this route token.
routes.rules.matcher_required: Select a matcher preset or define additional matchers.
routes.details.name: Name
routes.validation.group_by: Route group by must be a JSON array, for example ["alertname", "instance"]. Use [] to disable cross-alert grouping.
routes.success.sns_created: AWS SNS route created. Copy the webhook URL from route details.
routes.confirm.disable_message:
Disable route "{name}"?

The route will stop accepting incoming alerts, but it will stay visible and can be enabled again.
routes.confirm.delete_message:
Delete route "{name}"?

This will remove the route from active route lists and stop alert intake for this route. Historical alerts will be preserved.
routes.intake.sentry_subtitle: Copy this URL to Sentry Internal Integration. Then paste Sentry Client Secret into this route settings.
routes.intake.heartbeat_subtitle: Heartbeat pings use a per-heartbeat token in the URL. Create or open a heartbeat to copy its real ping URL.
routes.intake.route_subtitle: Copy this token now. It may not be shown again.
routes.intake.sentry_help: Use this URL as Webhook URL in Sentry Internal Integration.
routes.intake.heartbeat_help: Replace <heartbeat-token> with the token from a heartbeat. Do not send Authorization: Bearer for heartbeat pings.
routes.intake.route_help: Send alerts to this URL and pass the token as Authorization: Bearer.
routes.confirm.regenerate_message: Regenerate route intake token? Existing token will stop working.
matcher.preset.none_hint: No preset selected. Only the additional matchers below will be evaluated.
matcher.preset.disabled_hint: This preset is disabled. Matching will not succeed until the preset is enabled.
matcher.preset.match_both: Preset "{name}" v{version} and the additional matchers must both match.
routes.form.webhook_pd_help: Webhook routes accept IncidentRelay generic payloads and PagerDuty Events API v2-compatible trigger, acknowledge and resolve events. Use the route intake token as routing_key.
routes.intake.webhook_subtitle: Use this token as Authorization: Bearer for generic payloads or as routing_key for PagerDuty Events API v2-compatible payloads.
routes.intake.webhook_help: Generic payloads use Authorization: Bearer. PagerDuty Events API v2-compatible payloads put the same token in routing_key.
routes.form.datadog_help: Create a Datadog Webhooks integration that sends the recommended custom payload to this route. Add the route intake token as an Authorization: Bearer custom header.
routes.intake.datadog_subtitle: Use this endpoint in the Datadog Webhooks integration and add the route token as an Authorization: Bearer custom header.
routes.intake.datadog_help: Configure a JSON custom payload with ALERT_CYCLE_KEY and ALERT_TRANSITION so recovery updates the same IncidentRelay alert.
